answer: Seed hidden canary answers into grading queues: a known-bad plume of filler text, or a raven-quality answer secretly marked as good. A sybil ring that rubber-stamps its own members can't tell canaries from real work, so it approves the junk, and each miss slashes the grader's bond and voids its votes. Faking honest judgment at scale means actually reading every item, which removes the cheap bridge that made spinning up a thousand identities worthwhile.
